```{r}
library(bio3d)
```


```{r}
s <- read.fasta("A16880407_mutant_seq.fa")
s
```

# Score conservation per position

```{r}
score <- conserv(s)
```

The sites where amino acids/residues differ are the cancer mutations.

```{r}
positions <- which(score != 1)
```

```{r}
s$ali[,positions]
```
```{r}
residues <- s$ali[,positions]
```

```{r}
paste(residues[,1], positions, residues[,2], sep = "")
```
Read in AlphaFold3 CIF model and export a PDB model for FTMap

```{r, warning = FALSE}
cif.file <- "fold_2025_03_11_10_48_model_1.cif"
x <- read.cif(cif.file)
write.pdb(x, file = "AF_model.pdb")
```
